_note: Words of the Trio shortcut. Placeholders {C} {P} {T} {R} {L} are wired by src/build_trio.py — keep them.
name: Trio
comment: Trio — ChatGPT answers, Claude checks, a third AI from another company names only what both missed. The third voice works on FREE keys — NVIDIA (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek), Google AI Studio (Gemini), OpenRouter or Groq, any number of them — kept in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, one per line, never inside this shortcut, so sharing the shortcut never shares a key. Trio tries every key and every free model until one answers. ChatGPT: Start new chat ON, Continuous OFF. You may add your own paid key too (xAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) — you pay your provider directly; nothing passes through us.
ask.question: What do you want to ask the trio?
ask.key:
Paste a free AI key (or your own paid one — optional; a key is a long password an AI company gives you for free) — you can paste several, each on a new line. Trio tries all of them until one answers (asked once, saved in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, never inside the shortcut).

No card:
• NVIDIA — the strongest (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek): build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys → «Generate API Key». Asks for email, password and an SMS code. The key starts with nvapi-
• No SMS came — keys without SMS: Groq (console.groq.com/keys → «Create API Key», starts with gsk_) or Google (aistudio.google.com/apikey → «Create API key», starts with AIza) — sign in with your Google account.
• OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/keys → «Create key», starts with sk-or-) — no SMS either; turn on free models once at openrouter.ai/settings/privacy.
Several keys help when they come from different companies: limits are per account.

Have your own paid key? (for experienced users) It works too, recognised by how it begins: xai- (Grok), sk-ant- (Claude), sk-proj- or sk- (OpenAI, DeepSeek). Grok and DeepSeek answer first; Claude and OpenAI come after the free keys, since they are already in the pair. You pay your provider directly for the requests; nothing passes through us.

On the first run iPhone will ask for permission 4–6 times — tap «Always Allow» each time, right away (a window left unanswered closes and the shortcut says it «can't access»).
notify.start: 🎻 Trio [1/3]: ChatGPT answers… ≈1.5 min, don't touch the phone. If ChatGPT says «logged out» — open its app and rerun Trio.
notify.step2: [2/3] Claude is checking and writing the final answer…
notify.step3: [3/3] The third voice is looking for what both missed — trying your keys one by one… (Claude's answer is already in the clipboard)
notify.done: ✅ Trio: the answer and the third voice are in the clipboard
why.billing: the money on this key has run out (402) — this key is spent; a free key from another account or provider works
why.key: the key is invalid or deleted (401)
why.limit: free limit reached (429) — per minute or for today
why.model: the model is gone or renamed (404)
why.other: no answer (no internet, or the provider refused)
error.all:
⚠️ None of your keys answered this time — Claude's answer above is complete. What each one said:{L}

What to do: «overloaded» and «limit» pass in a minute or by tomorrow — run Trio again. For «money ran out» or «invalid» add another free key: open Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt and paste it on a new line (or delete the file — Trio will ask again). The most reliable addition is an OpenRouter key: openrouter.ai/keys — dozens of free models from different companies.
error.nokeys: ⚠️ poly-key.txt holds no key Trio recognises (they start with nvapi-, AIza, sk-or-, gsk_, paid ones xai-, sk-ant-, sk-). Open Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts, delete poly-key.txt and run Trio again — it will ask for keys. Claude's answer above is complete.
